title: The Five Works of Fire: Love's Operations in the Mingled Cosmos
description: Fire as the cosmic signature of love itself, performing five complete works upon every receptive substance: it consumes, separates four likenesses (fire/light vs. smoke/vapor — the mingled state), imparts taste and savor (sweetness of divine good, salt of mingled truth), shapes form (vessels molded by artisans), and reveals light for sight. Five — the standard measure of completeness in receptive form — gives the full articulation of how love acts at the natural-rational interface.
